review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5) of Annotate's Review touching pairs dialog, its count mode (annotation_counts, counts of 9 and more) and the Embeddings screen's raw TIFF crop text. No native-speaker sign-off.

records.translation: 标注计数

records.source: Treat the Annotate column as counts rather than classes. The + and - keys change the focused crop's count, # types any number, and counts of 10 and more are stored as entered instead of being read as model suggestions. Suggest is off while it is on. Default False.
records.translation: 将 Annotate 列视为计数而非类别。+ 和 - 键改变当前裁剪图像的计数，# 可输入任意数字，10 及以上的计数按输入值保存，而不会被读取为模型建议。开启时建议功能关闭。默认 False。

records.key: A measurements database lets you choose which objects to embed. A crop folder takes every PNG in it, or, with no PNG, every TIFF, read raw: 16-bit values and every channel are kept.
records.source: A measurements database lets you choose which objects to embed. A crop folder takes every PNG in it, or, with no PNG, every TIFF, read raw: 16-bit values and every channel are kept.
records.translation: 使用测量数据库时，可以选择要生成嵌入向量的对象；使用裁剪图像文件夹时，则处理其中的所有 PNG；如果没有 PNG，则以原始方式读取其中的所有 TIFF：保留 16 位数值和所有通道。

records.key: Folder of images with the same names as the masks, shown under the outlines. It may be the masks folder when the labels are one plane of the same stack. Empty draws the objects alone. Default empty.
records.source: Folder of images with the same names as the masks, shown under the outlines. It may be the masks folder when the labels are one plane of the same stack. Empty draws the objects alone. Default empty.
records.translation: 与掩膜同名的图像所在的文件夹，显示在轮廓下方。当标签是同一图像堆栈中的一个平面时，可以是掩膜文件夹本身。留空时仅绘制对象。默认为空。

records.key: Folder of label images (.npy, .tif or .png), one per field. Default empty.
records.source: Folder of label images (.npy, .tif or .png), one per field. Default empty.
records.translation: 标签图像（.npy、.tif 或 .png）所在的文件夹，每个视野一个。默认为空。

records.source: How many in this crop? 0 clears.
records.translation: 此裁剪图像中有多少个？0 表示清除。

records.source: Label A is outlined white and label B yellow. 1 merge (one object cut in two), 2 keep apart (two objects), 3 cannot tell, 0 clear, arrow keys move.
records.translation: 标签 A 以白色勾勒轮廓，标签 B 以黄色勾勒。1 合并（一个对象被切成两个），2 保持分开（两个对象），3 无法判断，0 清除，方向键移动。

records.key: Show touching objects two at a time, label A outlined white and label B yellow, and record whether they are one object cut in two or two objects. Verdicts go to the merge column of the set's png_list.
records.source: Show touching objects two at a time, label A outlined white and label B yellow, and record whether they are one object cut in two or two objects. Verdicts go to the merge column of the set's png_list.
records.translation: 每次显示两个相互接触的对象，标签 A 以白色勾勒轮廓，标签 B 以黄色勾勒，并记录它们是被切成两个的一个对象还是两个对象。判定结果写入该集合 png_list 的 merge 列。

records.key: Store the annotation column as counts: + and - change the focused crop's count, # types any number, and counts of 10 and more are kept as entered. Suggest is off for a count column. Default off.
records.source: Store the annotation column as counts: + and - change the focused crop's count, # types any number, and counts of 10 and more are kept as entered. Suggest is off for a count column. Default off.
records.translation: 将标注列存储为计数：+ 和 - 改变当前裁剪图像的计数，# 可输入任意数字，10 及以上的计数按输入值保存。计数列不使用建议功能。默认关闭。

records.key: Suggest is off for a count column: a suggested class would be stored as a number that reads as a count.
records.source: Suggest is off for a count column: a suggested class would be stored as a number that reads as a count.
records.translation: 计数列不使用建议功能：建议的类别会被存储为数字，从而被当作计数读取。

records.key: The least share of the smaller object's edge two labels must have in common to be reviewed. Default 0.05.
records.source: The least share of the smaller object's edge two labels must have in common to be reviewed. Default 0.05.
records.translation: 两个标签需要共有的边界占较小对象边界的最小比例，达到此比例才会进入审核。默认 0.05。

records.key: The most pairs to put in the set, in file and label order; 0 takes every pair. Default 0.
records.source: The most pairs to put in the set, in file and label order; 0 takes every pair. Default 0.
records.translation: 放入集合的标签对最大数量，按文件和标签顺序选取；0 表示选取所有标签对。默认 0。

records.key: The set could not be read: {reason}
records.source: The set could not be read: {reason}
records.translation: 无法读取集合：{reason}
判定结果未保存：{reason}

records.key: Up to three image planes, comma-separated, shown as red, green and blue; one plane is shown grey. Default 0,1,2.
records.source: Up to three image planes, comma-separated, shown as red, green and blue; one plane is shown grey. Default 0,1,2.
records.translation: 最多三个图像平面，以逗号分隔，分别显示为红色、绿色和蓝色；只有一个平面时显示为灰色。默认 0,1,2。

records.key: What the labels are. It goes into every pair's file name. Default cell.
records.source: What the labels are. It goes into every pair's file name. Default cell.
records.translation: 标签所代表的对象。该名称会写入每个标签对的文件名。默认 cell。

records.key: Where the set is written: pair images under data/merge_pairs and verdicts in measurements/measurements.db. Default empty.
records.source: Where the set is written: pair images under data/merge_pairs and verdicts in measurements/measurements.db. Default empty.
records.translation: 集合的写入位置：标签对图像写入 data/merge_pairs，判定结果写入 measurements/measurements.db。默认为空。

records.key: Which plane of a multi-plane file holds the labels; -1 is the last. Default 0.
records.source: Which plane of a multi-plane file holds the labels; -1 is the last. Default 0.
records.translation: 多平面文件中存放标签的平面；-1 表示最后一个。默认 0。
全部
